## 简体中文

### 修复

- 首个窗口预览立即显示；已有预览可见时，需短暂稳定悬停才切换到另一应用。
- 指针快速掠过任务栏时取消过期的预览切换任务，仅让最终悬停的应用执行切换动画。

## English

### Fixed

- Kept the first window preview immediate while requiring a short stable hover before switching an already visible preview to another app.
- Canceled stale preview switch tasks during fast taskbar pointer movement so only the final hovered app animates into place.
